what_it_does: Kubernetes is a cloud system for managing containers (packaged applications). This work addresses the problem of running mutually-distrustful tenants (separate users/organizations) safely on shared Kubernetes clusters. The paper shows that Kubernetes' built-in isolation mechanisms (namespaces and role-based access control) are insufficient for truly hostile environments. It proposes multiple solutions: virtual control planes that give each tenant their own isolated Kubernetes management layer, container sandboxes using lightweight virtual machines, and automated policy hardening tools.
